build_xmod_model: build an XMOD multilingual model instance with XMODEncoder from args and task dictionary
load_xmod_pretrained: load a pretrained XMOD model from a hub URL or local checkpoint path
run_xmod_forward: run the XMOD model forward pass with source tokens and optional language ID
extract_xmod_features: extract features from the XMODEncoder using extract_features with source tokens
configure_xmod_architecture: configure an XMOD model architecture like xmod_base or xmod_large_prenorm with language list
